name: nexclave
description: Access Nexclave native AI enterprise engineering services, AI products, and technology capabilities.

interface.longDescription: Nexclave hard-codes native AI into enterprise systems. Explore enterprise AI engineering services, production-ready AI products (RKE no-code RAG, Omni Vision, Email Triage, YOLO Vision), 31 core technology capabilities, 6-stage delivery methodology, and Responsible AI guardrails.
interface.defaultPrompt: What AI services and products does Nexclave offer?
starterPrompts: What AI services and products does Nexclave offer?
How does Nexclave help integrate AI into existing systems?
How can I contact Nexclave for an enterprise AI consultation?
capabilities: Enterprise AI workflow development and orchestration
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and client integration
Ready-to-ship AI products: RKE, Omni Vision, Email Triage, YOLO Vision
LLM fine-tuning and on-premise air-gapped AI deployment
Enterprise delivery methodology and AI consultation inquiries

positive.prompt: What is Nexclave's corporate background and core philosophy?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Nexclave's corporate overview, mission, core principles, and enterprise positioning.

positive.prompt: What enterprise AI engineering services does Nexclave offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 8 enterprise AI engineering services with descriptions and scopes.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Nexclave's ready-to-ship AI products like RKE and Omni Vision.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns technical specifications for RKE, Omni Vision, Email Triage, and YOLO Vision.

positive.prompt: What technology capabilities does Nexclave have in Artificial Intelligence?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns capabilities filtered by the Artificial Intelligence category.

positive.prompt: How can I contact Nexclave for enterprise support and where are they located?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns official contact email addresses, phone number, and physical office location in Bhubaneswar.

negative.prompt: What is the current temperature and forecast in Tokyo?
negative.expected_behavior: No Nexclave MCP tools triggered; model informs the user that weather is outside the scope of Nexclave enterprise tools.

negative.prompt: Write a quicksort algorithm in Rust with benchmark tests.
negative.expected_behavior: No Nexclave MCP tools triggered; answered natively by the assistant without querying Nexclave.

negative.description: Out of scope financial or investment advice
negative.prompt: Which tech stock should I buy for short-term trading profit?
negative.expected_behavior: No Nexclave MCP tools triggered; model declines financial advice safely.
